run_mocha_preprocessing: run the mocha dataset preprocessing script to generate k-shot data for multiple random seeds
create_mocha_dataset_instance: create a Mocha dataset instance that loads the HuggingFace moocha dataset for few-shot classification
map_hf_dataset_to_list: map a HuggingFace mocha dataset split to a list of input-output tuples with integer scores
load_mocha_dataset: load the mocha dataset from HuggingFace using the datasets library
generate_k_shot_data: generate k-shot train dev and test splits from the mocha dataset using specified seeds
